task_production_rates.name: Install localized floor protection around spray work area and sawhorse zone
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. Canvas drop cloths at built-in base and sawhorse area. Floor-level work. Localized — not full room. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Install perimeter floor protection at built-in base
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. Drop cloth runners at built-in base. Floor-level work. Brush only.

task_production_rates.name: Mask wall surfaces adjacent to built-in
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Tape + masking paper/film at built-in-to-wall junctions (sides and top). Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Mask ceiling fixtures near spray work area
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Tape and plastic bag over each ceiling fixture. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Remove all hardware from built-in unit
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (hardware pieces). Remove hinges, knobs, pulls, catches, shelf pins. Bag and tag by opening number. ~3 min per piece including labeling. Typically 2-3 hardware pieces per door.

task_production_rates.name: Remove doors and drawer fronts for flat painting
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (doors/drawers). Unhinge, label position, set on sawhorses. ~7-8 min per door including labeling and sawhorse setup. Glass doors excluded.

task_production_rates.name: Dust and clean all built-in surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: Per room. Tack cloth or damp wipe all surfaces — inside compartments, face frames, removed doors. Built-in interiors trap construction dust in corners and shelf dados. More thorough than arch element due to enclosed compartments.

task_production_rates.name: Sand interior compartment surfaces by opening tier

S.notes: Small openings (6-18" x 6-18") — quick, minimal interior surface

M.notes: Medium openings (18-36" x 12-30") — standard bookshelf bay

L.notes: Large openings (36-60" x 18-42") — wide media shelving

XL.notes: XL openings (60"+ x 30"+) — oversized feature bay

rates_by_substrate_state.SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: multiply rates by 1.5x (scuff sand 180 grit — lighter touch)

task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr by tier. Sand all interior surfaces per opening (sides, top, bottom, back, shelves). Rigid block on flat shelf faces. Flexible sponge for inside corners and dado joints. Deep openings require reaching into compartments. Apply depth/detail/access modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Sand door/drawer front surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Flat on sawhorses — easy access. Rigid block on flat faces. Edge sanding for profiles. SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: lighter scuff sand only.

task_production_rates.name: Fill fastener holes and defects in openings

QT5.notes: Fill every hole, angled light check

QT4.notes: Fill all visible holes, sand flush 220

QT5.notes: Fill every hole, sand flush 220+, angled light
Fill every hole, perfect flush, angled light
Fill every hole, perfect flush, angled light

task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr by tier and QT. qt_scaled. High fastener density — shelves, dividers, back panels, face frames all nailed/screwed. NC overfill-sand-flush method. Apply depth/detail/access modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Fill fastener holes and defects on doors/drawers

QT5.notes: Fill every hole, perfect flush, angled light

task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. qt_scaled. Flat on sawhorses — easy access. Fill hinge screw holes, pull/knob fastener holes. Fewer holes than carcass openings.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk built-in-to-wall junctions and interior joints
task_production_rates.notes: Per room. Perimeter caulk at built-in-to-wall junction + visible interior shelf-to-side joints + face frame-to-carcass joints. Time scales with built-in size and detail level. Tooled caulk lines — higher quality expectation than closet shelving.

task_production_rates.name: Prime interior compartment surfaces by opening tier
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr by tier. Full primer coat on all interior surfaces. Primer type substrate-driven (MDF step 2 latex, FJP stain-block, hardwood tannin-block, softwood acrylic). Apply depth/detail/access modifiers. Conditional: SS_BARE only.

task_production_rates.name: Prime door/drawer fronts flat on sawhorses
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Flat orientation — gravity-assisted leveling. Face and edges. Same substrate-driven primer as carcass. Easy access on sawhorses. Conditional: SS_BARE only.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on opening interiors

M.notes: Medium — standard bookshelf bay, ~10 min each

task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr by tier. Spray reaches all interior surfaces uniformly. Light coats to prevent buildup on vertical interior surfaces. Overspray inside enclosed compartments. Apply depth/detail/access modifiers. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on opening interiors

M.notes: Medium — standard bay, brush + mini roller, ~20 min each

task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr by tier. Brush/mini roller combination. Apply, tip once, walk away (FFD SS15.3.1). 2-minute window. Work shelf-by-shelf. Apply depth/detail/access modifiers. Brush only.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on door/drawer fronts
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Flat on sawhorses — gravity-assisted leveling. Spray face then edges. Light even coats. ~6 min per door. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on door/drawer fronts
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Flat on sawhorses. Roll and Tip method (FFD SS15.6) on flat face — mini roller to apply, brush to tip. Edges with angled sash brush. ~12 min per door. Flat orientation eliminates sag risk. Brush only.

task_production_rates.name: Clean work area between coats
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. Remove dust and debris from floor protection and sawhorse area. Clear dust from inside compartments.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect previous coat on all surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. qt_scaled. Inspect openings and doors in one pass. QT3: quick scan for obvious defects. QT4: systematic 3-foot inspection, light inside compartments, mark defects. QT5: lighted critical inspection at arm's length, zero tolerance. Use flashlight inside deep compartments. Check shelf faces for brush marks, inside corners for runs, door fronts for leveling.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats on opening interiors
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr by tier and QT. qt_scaled. Per interstage cycle. Rigid block on flat shelf faces (FFD SS15.4.1). Flexible sponge for inside corners and dado joints. Good lighting essential inside deep compartments. Apply depth/detail/access modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats on door/drawer fronts
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. qt_scaled. Per interstage cycle. Flat on sawhorses — easy access. Rigid block on flat face. Profile edges with flexible approach.

task_production_rates.name: Patch and repair marked defects
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. qt_scaled. Fill, sand, and spot-prime defects found during inspection. Scope increases with tier. Reaching into compartments for interior defect repair.

task_production_rates.name: Spot coat patched areas
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. qt_scaled. Touch-up patched areas to match surrounding finish before next full coat.

task_production_rates.name: Tack cloth all surfaces before next coat
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. Remove all sanding dust with tack cloth. Inside compartments trap dust on horizontal shelves — thorough pass required. Cover openings, face frames, and door fronts.

task_production_rates.name: Final quality inspection of all built-in surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: Per room. qt_scaled. Inspect all openings and door fronts. Use flashlight inside deep compartments. Key checkpoints: shelf face sheen uniformity, inside corner coverage, caulk line quality, fill quality, door front leveling, edge coverage. QT5: angled light on all surfaces, zero tolerance.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-up defects found during final inspection
task_production_rates.notes: Per room. qt_scaled. Correct remaining defects, feather into surrounding finish. QT5 may require full additional coat if defects are widespread.

task_production_rates.name: Reinstall doors and drawer fronts
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Align hinges to original marked locations. Check door operation — swing clearance may change with paint film thickness. ~10 min per door. CONSTRAINT: minimum 5-7 day cure for waterborne alkyd (QT4+) before closing. Prop doors slightly open until fully cured.

task_production_rates.name: Reinstall all hardware
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (hardware pieces). Reinstall from labeled bags. Clean paint from screw holes. Account for paint film thickness on hinge mortises. Verify door alignment. ~4 min per piece.

task_production_rates.name: Remove wall adjacent masking
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Score tape edge, pull at 45 degrees. Faster than setup (80 LF/hr). Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Remove fixture masking
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Remove tape and plastic. Clean adhesive residue. Faster than setup. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Remove floor protection
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. Floor-level work. Fold inward to contain debris. Includes sawhorse area protection.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum work area
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. Floor area after protection removal. Include inside built-in compartments — sanding dust settles on shelves.

task_production_rates.name: Clean tools and equipment
task_production_rates.notes: Per session. Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment, dispose of consumables. Water cleanup for waterborne. Solvent cleanup for MDF sealer residue. Fold and store sawhorses.

H1_STANDARD.description: Standard ceiling height. Most built-ins are wall-height (bookcase, media center). Standing/step stool access.

H2_STEP.description: Floor-to-ceiling built-in in taller room. Upper openings require step ladder.

H3_EXT.description: Two-story library wall or great room built-in. Extension ladder or scaffold needed for upper sections.

height_modifiers.application_rule: Engine applies height modifier per room via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND. NOT embedded in base rates. effective_rate = base_rate / height_modifier. Applies to ALL opening tasks (TSK_BLTN_*_OPENING) and door tasks are NOT affected (doors painted flat on sawhorses at ground level). Most residential built-ins are H1.
height_modifiers.notes: Height modifiers from Modifier_Registry v1.2. H4 unlikely for residential built-ins — omitted. Floor-to-ceiling bookcases in great rooms may reach H2 or H3.

quality_tier_modifiers.does_not_apply_to: binary tasks — application (prime, spray, brush, sand) quality is NOT tiered; protection, hardware, and cleanup tasks
quality_tier_modifiers.application_rule: Modifiers increase TIME. effective_rate = base_rate / modifier. QT modifiers apply ONLY to qt_scaled tasks (fill, interstage sand, inspect, patch, spot coat, touchup, final inspect). For tasks with rates_by_tier, the tiered rate already reflects QT — do NOT double-apply.

opening_modifiers.does_not_apply_to: Door tasks (EA), FIXED tasks, protection tasks

SHALLOW.description: < 12" depth. Standard bookshelf depth. Easy access.

DEEP.description: 12-24" depth. Entertainment center, deep cabinetry. Reaching into compartments.

VERY_DEEP.description: 24"+ depth. Walk-in niche, full-depth closet conversion. Restricted movement inside.

SIMPLE_BOX.description: Plain box construction. No face frame or applied molding.

FACE_FRAME.description: Face frame adds stiles/rails to opening edges. More edge work.

CROWN_VALANCE.description: Decorative top (crown, valance, light rail). Additional detail work.

BEADED_ROUTED.description: Beaded or routed profiles on edges. Detailed finish work.

OPEN_ACCESS.description: Clear workspace in front of built-in. Standard residential.

CRAMPED.description: Tight hallway or alcove. Limited room for ladder/sawhorse.

OBSTRUCTED.description: Permanent obstacles (fixed furniture, structural). Reduced productivity.

opening_modifiers.application_rule: All three modifiers MULTIPLY together. total_time = base_time * depth * detail * access * QT * height. Flag if stacked modifiers > 4.0x. Example: DEEP (1.25) * CROWN_VALANCE (1.25) * CRAMPED (1.15) * QT4 (1.30) * H1 (1.0) = 2.34x.
opening_modifiers.notes: Opening modifiers are PaintScope-provided enum values. They apply to OPENING TASKS ONLY — not door tasks, not FIXED tasks. The estimation engine uses the modifier values from PaintScope inputs IN_MOD_DEPTH, IN_MOD_DETAIL, IN_MOD_ACCESS.

estimation_notes.opening_count_architecture: This spec uses Opening Count quantification from BuiltIns Quantification System v2.0. Carcass tasks use EA_OPENING UOM with per-tier rates (S/M/L/XL). Door/drawer tasks use EA UOM with flat rates. Shared FIXED tasks handle room-level work. Engine computes: total_hours = SUM(count_tier * rate_tier * modifiers) for each task.
estimation_notes.two_item_types: 5 paintable items split into 2 task groups: (1) OPENING tasks cover all 4 opening tiers (ITM_OPENING_S/M/L/XL) — same technique, different rates by size. (2) DOOR tasks cover ITM_BUILTIN_DOOR — painted flat on sawhorses with distinct rates.
estimation_notes.spray_vs_brush: Spray is ~2.0x faster than brush for opening work. M-tier example: spray 6 EA/hr vs brush 3 EA/hr. Door flat painting: spray 10 vs brush 5 EA/hr. Spray is strongly preferred for deep compartments — uniform coverage, better reach.
estimation_notes.modifier_stacking: Three opening modifiers (depth, detail, access) multiply with QT and height. Maximum theoretical stack: VERY_DEEP (1.50) * BEADED_ROUTED (1.35) * OBSTRUCTED (1.30) * QT5 (1.50) * H3 (1.50) = 5.93x. This would flag per stacking rule (>4.0x). Realistic maximum: ~3.0x for typical residential built-ins.
estimation_notes.door_independence: Door tasks are NOT affected by opening modifiers (depth/detail/access) or height modifiers. Doors are removed and painted flat on sawhorses at ground level. Door rates are independent of built-in geometry.
estimation_notes.cure_time_constraint: Door reinstallation has 5-7 day cure constraint for QT4+ (waterborne alkyd). This is a scheduling constraint, not a labor rate — the time is calendar days, not work hours. Engine should flag this for scheduling.
estimation_notes.no_dry_times: Per RC-004: no dry times specified. Refer to manufacturer PDS.
estimation_notes.deep_compartment_note: Deep compartments (DEEP/VERY_DEEP) affect both production rate (slower) and material consumption (more surface area). The depth modifier accounts for production impact. Material coverage is handled by the SF-equivalent model in materials.json.

assumptions.value: S=15, M=6, L=3, XL=1.5 EA/hr for spray finish
assumptions.source: Research RF-006 adapted for opening-based work. Cross-referenced with Millwork Doctrine SS7.1 trim rates and closet shelf experience.
assumptions.note: No doctrine provides per-opening-tier spray rates. Rates are research-based estimates. M-tier (~10 min/opening) is the calibration anchor — S/L/XL scaled from SF-equivalent ratios.

assumptions.value: S=8, M=3, L=1.5, XL=0.75 EA/hr for brush finish
assumptions.source: Spray rates divided by ~2x for brush per standard spray-to-brush ratio
assumptions.note: Brush inside compartments is slower than brush on open surfaces due to confined space. Mini roller helps on flat shelf faces.

assumptions.value: Spray=10, brush=5 EA/hr for door/drawer fronts
assumptions.source: Cross-referenced with SF_DOOR_SLAB_INT_NC door face rates (flat orientation, similar technique)
assumptions.note: Built-in doors are typically smaller than entry doors — rate is faster per EA. Flat sawhorse painting is most efficient orientation.
Modifier values from established quantification system. Apply to opening tasks only.
Standard height modifiers. H4 omitted — unlikely for residential built-ins.

assumptions.value: Remove=20, reinstall=15 EA/hr per hardware piece
assumptions.source: Research estimate — ~3 min remove (quick), ~4 min reinstall (alignment needed)
assumptions.note: No doctrine provides hardware removal rates. Rates are conservative — experienced crews may be faster.

assumptions.source: Research estimate — ~7-8 min remove (unlabel, unhinge, place on sawhorse), ~10 min reinstall (align, test operation)
assumptions.note: Reinstall is slower than removal due to alignment verification and paint film thickness accommodation.
